effectiveCondition: This record is effective only after owner-reviewed merge to main and execution from an exact tracked-clean local main equal to freshly fetched origin/main.

approvalAuthority.requestBasis: The repository owner approved continuation after connecting and authorizing one physical Android target, merging the Samsung package-absence compatibility correction, and producing the passing read-only target-discovery receipt.

apiLevelBindingCompatibilityAmendment.reason: The first merged physical-campaign Preflight stopped because PowerShell 7 parsed inline integer casts in a positional Assert-Equal call as additional positional arguments.
apiLevelBindingCompatibilityAmendment.observedError: A positional parameter cannot be found that accepts argument 'Physical target API level'.
apiLevelBindingCompatibilityAmendment.scopeChange: Resolve observed and expected API levels into typed local variables and pass them through named Assert-Equal parameters.

identitySeparation.subject: one owner-controlled approved SI non-admin test identity used on the exact physical target
identitySeparation.operator: a different approved admin identity used only through the governed authority writer

requiredPhases.operation: Fresh Google/Firebase sign-in on the exact installed Build 6 target and same-process arrival at the approved home surface.
requiredEvidence: installed APK hash, package, version and signer remain exact
home navigation markers are present
login, loading, error and awaiting-approval markers are absent
no account email, raw uid or Google identity is retained

requiredPhases.operation: Run one authenticated manual full sync from the fresh installation with zero queued local business writes.
requiredEvidence: manual sync returns to a successful non-busy state
pending local write count is zero before and after
the receipt hashes the UI and local diagnostic evidence
no synthetic production business document is created

requiredPhases.operation: Disable the active device network transports, prove the signed-in shell remains safe offline, restore the exact prior transport state, and complete another manual sync.
requiredEvidence: transport state before disconnection is captured
offline UI evidence is captured without a false successful remote mutation
the original transport state is restored even on failure
post-reconnect manual sync succeeds with zero queued local writes

requiredPhases.operation: Exercise authenticated listeners and sync during a bounded intermittent-network profile, restore transport state, and verify recovery.
requiredEvidence: the degradation profile and bounded duration are recorded
the app does not report a false completed mutation while disconnected
transport state is restored even on failure
post-profile manual sync succeeds with zero queued local writes

requiredPhases.operation: Use the governed authority writer from the separate admin identity to revoke the subject, then prove the physical client loses approved access before its next privileged operation.
requiredEvidence: authority receipt and audit evidence are privacy-minimized and request-bound
the client reaches the awaiting-approval surface without relaunch
no privileged operation succeeds after revocation
restoration uses a separate governed request and restores the exact captured role set

requiredPhases.operation: Temporarily replace the restored subject roles with operations-only through the governed writer and prove multiple admin/SI-only surfaces are unavailable before exact-role restoration.
requiredEvidence: the Admin module is visibly limited and cannot be opened
Template Authoring, Template Publisher, Knowledge Governance and Support Diagnostics are absent
at least one server-authoritative admin/SI mutation attempt is denied where safely observable
the original approval and exact role set are restored through the governed writer

authorizedOperations: verify the exact merged promotion, discovery receipt, governed package, embedded APK, signer and hashed physical target
install the exact non-debuggable Build 6 APK once on the bound physical target and launch only that package
use one owner-controlled non-admin test Google identity for Firebase Authentication and own-profile hydration
perform ordinary own-user fcmToken maintenance caused by sign-in, sign-out or token refresh
run manual full sync only while the fresh-install pending local business-write count is zero
temporarily disable and restore device Wi-Fi/mobile-data state for the offline and bounded intermittent-network phases
use a separate approved admin identity and the governed authority writer for request-bound revoke, approve and exact-role replacement steps
read the subject's own profile, governed authority receipts/audits and minimum phase-specific Firebase evidence
capture privacy-minimized UI, device, network, local-diagnostic and authority evidence outside the repository
prohibitedOperations: use an emulator, second physical device, second subject identity or artifact other than exact Build 6
retain a raw ADB serial, raw build fingerprint, Android ID, account email, Firebase uid, access token or business payload
use the subject identity as the authority operator or revoke the last approved admin
create synthetic production tickets, workflows, directives, templates, abnormalities or other business records as a sync marker
clear application data, uninstall, downgrade, rebuild, resign or modify the governed APK
mutate authority by direct Firestore write, Admin SDK shortcut or any path other than the governed callable
leave the subject revoked, role-narrowed or with a role set different from the captured initial state
leave Wi-Fi or mobile-data state different from its captured initial state
deploy or mutate Firebase, Rules, Functions, IAM, App Check or distribution configuration
pilot handout, external upload, Play Console, Firebase App Distribution, public link or unrestricted distribution
claim DEVICE_PROVED, close STAGE2D-F4 or close P-07 before all six phase receipts are independently adjudicated
